newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 5.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie joins other African heads of state at Franco-African summit in Burkina Faso.
- Accord for 11 billion CFA agriculture sector loan signed between Ivory Coast and the African Development Bank.
- Officials of French chocolate group Cemoi meet Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan over their plans to set up an operation in Ivory Coast.
- Ruling Democratic Party has already started scheming ahead of December 29 partial elections in three central districts. Legislative elections were postponed there last year because of violence.
- Head of state-owned Ivorian telephone company CI-TELCOM says subscribers to blame for chaos at paying centres -- they all wait till the last day to pay their bills.
